''See also: [[Jai Long Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Jai]] Long was a highly talented [[sacred artist]] from the [[Jai clan]] who specialized in the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]]. Recognized as a prodigy during his youth, he reached the peak of [[Jade]] by age thirteen but was prevented from advancing further by his clan's elders. Instead of being allowed to progress within his family, he was sent to the [[Desolate Wilds]] to serve as an attendant for the [[Sandviper sect]], a move intended to benefit his clan without causing them social disgrace. Throughout his career, [[Jai]] Long rose through the ranks of [[advancement]], eventually reaching the level of [[Truegold]]. He was known for his combat prowess and his use of a white spear that could absorb the power of defeated [[Remnants]]. His fighting style incorporated [[white madra]] and the forging of serpent-like [[constructs]]. Despite his significant strength, he often felt a sense of bitterness regarding the rigid traditions and propriety enforced by the [[Jai clan]]'s Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch. In his later life, he served as a high-ranking representative for the [[Sandviper sect]] and was involved in various conflicts, including battles against [[Lindon]] and efforts to support his allies. He eventually achieved the rank of [[Gold]], which left him with a distinct [[Goldsign]] consisting of deep facial splits and blue light fangs. [[Jai]] Long ultimately met his end during an attack by a [[Dreadgod]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Jai]] Long is a tall, lean man who has been seen wearing ordinary dark or simple brown robes, sometimes adorned with a [[Twin Star emblem]]. He often wears red cloth wrapped tightly around his head as a The mask{{!}}mask, leaving only his eyes visible through the flowing Script{{!}}script covering the bandages. His physical features include blue, shark-like fangs and a jaw reshaped by a serpentine [[Remnant]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A practitioner of the [[sacred arts]], [[Jai]] Long believes that most individuals are too focused on acquiring strength rather than considering how to utilize it. He is an exile from the [[Jai clan]] and serves as the de facto leader of the [[Sandviper sect]]. He has been known to speak coldly to certain guardians and possesses a laugh that sounds like the cackling of a deranged murderer.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Jai]] Long follows the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]] and utilizes [[Stellar Spear madra]], including techniques such as [[Flowing Starlight]], [[Star's Edge]], and the Serpent's [[Shadow]]. He is a skilled spearman who has used the [[Ancestor’s Spear]] and can also fight with the halves of a broken spear. His abilities include spirit-sense{{!}}spiritual sense, the use of [[soulfire]]-enhanced [[madra]], and an [[Enforcer technique]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Highgold of the Jai clan}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A [[Highgold]] and [[sacred artist]], [[Jai]] Long believes that most individuals are too preoccupied with acquiring strength to contemplate its proper application.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c7">''Soulsmith'', chapter 7</ref> He has achieved the same level of [[advancement]] in the [[sacred arts]] as Sandviper Kral{{!}}Kral and reached the peak of [[Jade]] at thirteen years old.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c7" /> [[Jai]] Long is an exile from the [[Jai clan]] who was cast out due to his [[Remnant]], yet he possesses a foundation with the potential to reach [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9">''Soulsmith'', chapter 9</ref> Clad in ordinary dark robes and a scripted The mask{{!}}mask, he wears long strips of red cloth wrapped tightly around his head so that only his eyes are visible.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c7" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8">''Soulsmith'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9" /> In combat, he utilizes a spear and adopts a stance resembling a tiger about to pounce.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c7" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8" /> His [[Goldsign]] is a scarred and twisted face that he dislikes, and his laughter resembles the cackling of a deranged murderer.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c7" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Attendant of Sandviper sect}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|As an attendant of the [[Sandviper sect]], [[Jai]] Long observed the cages containing captured Miners{{!}}miners.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c11">''Soulsmith'', chapter 11</ref> This tall spearman wears a The mask{{!}}mask of red cloth and utilizes [[Stellar Spear madra]], possessing the physical strength of an [[Iron body]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c11" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13">''Soulsmith'', chapter 13</ref> Following the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]], he serves as the de facto leader of his sect.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref> A member of the [[Jai clan]] who emerged from the door with a red-wrapped head, he is predicted to potentially tear through the halls of his clan using a pure white spear that drinks the power of slain [[Remnants]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c18">''Soulsmith'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19">''Soulsmith'', chapter 19</ref> While there is a low probability he will be killed by a [[Jai]] [[Lowgold]] in battle or die in isolation after his sister persuades him to end his crusade, he is highly likely to be sabotaged by attackers before a duel and suppressed by the [[Jai Patriarch]] via a wound from [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19" /> [[Jai]] Long is predicted to take revenge for Sandviper Kral{{!}}Kral and is noted as a powerful individual who once outclassed [[Yerin]], whom he had faced before her current state.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c20">''Soulsmith'', chapter 20</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Rebellion in Serpent's Grave}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Located in [[Serpent's Grave]], [[Jai]] Long is an individual whom [[Lindon]] seeks to defeat.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c11">''Blackflame'', chapter 11</ref> His original objective involved killing two [[Jai]] Lowgold{{!}}Lowgolds to capture their [[Remnants]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c11" /> [[Yerin]] mentions him, noting that [[Lindon]] carries an obligation toward the man.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c12">''Blackflame'', chapter 12</ref> As a specter looming over the [[Trial]], he represents a threat that the [[Trial]] is intended to address as a first step toward his defeat.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c14">''Blackflame'', chapter 14</ref> [[Yerin]] believes that [[Jai]] Long will ultimately kill [[Lindon]], especially as he is involved in a rebellion.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c14" /><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c16">''Blackflame'', chapter 16</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Duel with Lindon}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|[[Jai]] Long is a [[Blackflame]] who serves as an opponent for [[Lindon]] to defeat, a goal [[Eithan]] uses as motivation.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c1">''Skysworn'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c3">''Skysworn'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c7">''Skysworn'', chapter 7</ref> During their duel, [[Lindon]] is at the mercy of [[Jai]] Long, who possesses [[Truegold]] [[madra]] in his skin and features blue, shark-like fangs.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c4">''Skysworn'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c5">''Skysworn'', chapter 5</ref> After casting the [[Ancestor's Spear]] aside, [[Jai]] Long scooped up [[Jai Chen]] and backed away.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c5" /> His attacks create serpent outlines, and the character is under an oath to serve the [[Jai clan]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c6">''Skysworn'', chapter 6</ref> While emitting a twisting [[white light]] from his chest, [[Jai]] Long cries out for help regarding his sister.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c6" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9">''Skysworn'', chapter 9</ref> Despite being previously targeted by a Snare [[binding]], [[Jai]] Long was the one who actually removed Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm{{!}}Lindon's arm.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c7" /> A victory for [[Jai]] Long would affect the reputation of his clan, and he is considered to be close to [[Eithan]]'s level.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c7" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9" /> Using a white-edged spear to fight [[blood-creatures]], he employs a [[cycling technique]] before departing without further words.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9" /> Having used the [[Ancestor's Spear]] to go from [[Highgold]] to [[Truegold]], this boy eventually defeats [[Lindon]] in their duel.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c10">''Skysworn'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c12">''Skysworn'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c16">''Skysworn'', chapter 16</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Ally of Kelsa}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|As an ally to [[Kelsa]], [[Jai]] Long pledged to facilitate the escape of her parents.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c7">''Bloodline'', chapter 7</ref> He spoke in a cold manner to the guardians of the [[Fallen Leaf School]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9">''Bloodline'', chapter 9</ref> His [[white madra]] manifests across his skin as shining, serpentine tattoos.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9" /> Despite interacting with [[Eithan]], [[Jai]] Long maintains no interest in the [[sacred arts]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c10">''Bloodline'', chapter 10</ref> Though he was not present on the [[cloudship]], he utilizes [[soulfire]]-enhanced [[madra]] and fights with the halves of a broken spear.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18">''Bloodline'', chapter 18</ref> Feeling exhausted and weak in [[spirit]], he was eventually carried by [[Jai Chen]] on a stretcher atop a hovering [[construct]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c18" /><ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c21">''Bloodline'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Member of Twin Stars}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Every morning, [[Jai]] Long engages in meditation regarding the nature of his [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c6">''Reaper'', chapter 6</ref> A member of the [[Sect of Twin Stars]], he is a peak [[Truegold]] who possesses [[soulfire]] within his [[spirit]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c11">''Reaper'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19">''Reaper'', chapter 19</ref> As he advances toward the rank of [[Underlord]], he utilizes an [[Enforcer technique]].<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c19" /><ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c24">''Reaper'', chapter 24</ref> He was also a member of the squad that suffered being battered and burned.<ref name="cradle-10-reaper-c24" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Sage of the Twin Stars}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|No longer wearing a The mask{{!}}mask, [[Jai]] Long now has a red strip of scripted cloth wrapped around his forehead.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5">''Dreadgod'', chapter 5</ref> His [[spirit]] has become much stronger, and blue light leaks from the inside of his mouth as he wears a [[Twin Star emblem]] on his outer robe.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5" /> [[Lindon]] addresses him as an honored [[Sage]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c5" /> Though his body was forged in [[soulfire]], he died after being targeted by [[madra]] of every aspect and earth eruptions.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17">''Dreadgod'', chapter 17</ref> His [[Remnant]] appeared as a blue-white, serpentine form.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" />}}
